messages:
ken: quick async check-in
ken: what I did: rolled a small routing policy tweak to favor low-cost variant for /v1/generate traffic (canary ~10%)
ken: blocker: noticed increased 429s from one region during a burst test, investigating whether batching window is too tight
ken: today: tune batching thresholds, validate canary metrics, and ping for CR review on the policy change

olivia: saw the 429 spike on grafana, looks correlated with token batching size drops around 03:40 UTC
olivia: curious if we should bump max_batch_tokens from 1024 -> 2048 for the canary only, then measure tail latency
olivia: quick snippet of the policy change I pushed to the canary:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  - match: "/v1/generate"
    prefer: low_cost_variant
    canary: 0.1
    batching:
      max_batch_tokens: 1024  # candidate to bump
```

ajay: pinging dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/edge/routing?orgId=1
ajay: current P95 token latency adds ~80ms when batch size grows beyond 1.5k tokens, so bumping might trade cost for latency
ajay: I'm ok with a canary-only bump if we keep the autoscale headroom and watch 429s + queue length

sam: CR #4821 is up for the policy diff — added tests for routing key fallthrough and a small e2e that runs against the canary variant
sam: requesting a quick review, cc @ken @olivia
sam: link: https://git.redwood/company/eng-platform/pulls/4821

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: eng-platform/canary-routing-policy v2026.03.17-rc3 -> deploying to us-west1-canary (started)

natalie: blocker here: running integ tests locally and seeing auth failures for a subset of requests, header parsing seems to strip trailing comma when multiple tokens present
natalie: log snippet: `warn auth: token parse failed: "Authorization: Bearer abc123, "`
natalie: haven't reproduced in staging yet, maybe related to recent header normalization middleware tweak

ken: thanks @natalie — looks like the header normalizer added a .trim() that accidentally dropped an empty trailing token, pushing a quick fix now
ken: test to run locally: `make integ TEST_FILTER=auth && curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer abc123, bearer def456' http://localhost:8080/v1/info`

olivia: I'll help run the staging matrix after deploy-bot finishes, especially the burst tests (50k requests/min) against us-west1-canary

ajay: I'll add an alert for sustained >5% 429s over 3m for the canary routing rule so we can auto-roll back if needed

sam: reviewed CR, left one small comment about logging verbosity, otherwise LGTM :thumbsup:

ken: summary: bumping canary batching is ok to try, rollback triggers in place, auth header fix going out now. I'll post follow-up with canary metrics in ~30m. Thanks everyone!
